{{Quote|Son, I wouldn't be so hasty if I were you.|Cad Bane, to Captain Jayfon|audio=IWouldntBeSoHastyIfIWereYou-HostageCrisis.flac|<ref name="TCWHostage" />}}
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Jayfon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who led a group of [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commandos]] against a team of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] led by the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] when the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters attempted to [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|raid]] the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

After Bane landed at the Executive Building's restricted landing platform without permission, Jayfon and a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of guards ordered Bane to surrender. When the captain ordered one of his subordinates to handcuff Bane, the bounty hunter [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] opened fire on the guards. Bane himself attacked Jayfon, snapping his neck and [[Death/Legends|killing]] him. The rest of the guards were also eliminated.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Put up your hands.''"<br />"''I've got business with the Senate. How 'bout you fellas step aside?|Jayfon and Cad Bane|audio=CadBaneBusinessWithTheSenate.flac|<ref name="TCWHostage" />}}
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Jayfon was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commandos]],<ref name="Art of SW:TCW">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref> a special unit of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]],<ref name="Hostage Crisis Ep Guide" /> in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="Hostage Crisis Date" /> After the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] was [[Raid on Ziro the Hutt's Coruscant club|arrested]] by the Republic for his participation in a plot to seize control of the [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal empire]] of his nephew, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]],<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars novelization">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref> the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] was hired to free Ziro from the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Along with a team of hunters, Bane set down on a restricted landing platform of Coruscant's [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] without permission in order to capture [[Senator/Legends|senators]] and force [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to release Ziro.<ref name="TCWHostage" />

[[File:CommandosConfrontBane-HC.png|thumb|left|250px|Captain Jayfon ordering Bane to surrender]]
As Bane disembarked his vehicle, Jayfon and several other Senate Commandos confronted the bounty hunter, and the captain ordered Bane to surrender. After Bane replied that he had business with the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and ordered the guards to step aside, Jayfon told the bounty hunter to drop to his knees, and one of the guards was sent to handcuff Bane.<ref name="TCWHostage" />

However, the bounty hunter [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] opened fire on the guards with her [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]], and Bane attacked the captain<ref name="TCWHostage" />&mdash;although Jayfon and his men had been prepared for a fight, they were taken by surprise.<ref name="Hasbro Commandos">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|pack=(Target Exclusive) Senate Commando Captain & Senate Commando|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCWExCommander-Commando.asp}}</ref> Pressing the guard against a vehicle, Bane grabbed Jayfon's head and snapped his neck, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him. The other Senate Commandos were dispatched by the other bounty hunters, and Bane ordered the [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] of his team to put on the uniforms of the deceased [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] to make it look as though the commandos were still at their post.<ref name="TCWHostage" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|On your knees! Raise your hands. Slowly.|Jayfon orders Bane to surrender|<ref name="TCWHostage" />}}
Although the no-nonsense Jayfon<ref name="Hostage Crisis Ep Guide" /> was a well-trained Senate Commando, his underestimation of Cad Bane's abilities ultimately cost him his life.<ref name="TCWHostage" /> Despite being prepared for a fight if necessary, he and his guards were taken by surprise by Bane and his accomplices.<ref name="Hasbro Commandos" /> 

==Equipment==
Jayfon was equipped with standard [[Color/Legends|blue]] Senate Commando [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. He also had a blue [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] which included a faceplate with a dark visor. Jayfon had an enlarged left [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]], decorated with the symbol of the Galactic Senate.<ref name="TCWHostage" /> The captain was armed with a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15 blaster]].<ref name="Hasbro Commandos" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Jayfon first appeared in "[[Hostage Crisis]]," the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] finale of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[March 20]], [[2009]].<ref name="Hostage Crisis Ep Guide" /> His name was revealed in the 2009 reference book ''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''. The book also revealed Jayfon and his commandos were inspired by the [[Wikipedia:Praetorian Guard|Praetorian Guards]] of [[Wikipedia:Ancient Rome|Ancient Rome]]. As a result, Jayfon's paint scheme was a mixture of Roman décor and ''[[Star Wars]]'' graphics. Concept art of Jayfon was created by [[Kilian Plunkett]] and [[Russell G. Chong]].<ref name="Art of SW:TCW" /> 

Captain Jayfon was voiced by [[Tom Kane]], who also voices [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]<ref name="Ambush Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode001.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Ambush}}</ref> and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] in the series.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode003.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref> Jayfon also appeared in the non-[[canon]]ical [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'' as a non-playable character in the "Hostage Crisis" level. After completing the level, he was available for purchase as "Senate Commando (Captain)" for use in the game's Free Play mode.<ref name="LEGO SW III">''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''</ref>
